evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies the HTTP server implementation in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
rationale: Fixes a regression where the HTTP server executes queued requests after sending a closing reply or receiving conflicting framing headers, violating RFC 9112. The PR description notes this is a regression from #35182 that permits pipelined commands (demonstrated with `setnetworkactive false`) to execute after a terminated connection.
